Class IntervalTask

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.scheduling.config.Task
org.springframework.scheduling.config.DelayedTask
org.springframework.scheduling.config.IntervalTask
Direct Known Subclasses:
FixedDelayTask, FixedRateTask
public class IntervalTask extends DelayedTask
Task 实现定义了一个 Runnable，该任务将在给定的毫秒间隔执行，具体是作为固定速率还是固定延迟取决于上下文。
Since:
3.2
Author:
Chris Beams, Arjen Poutsma
See Also:
  • ScheduledTaskRegistrar.addFixedRateTask(IntervalTask)
  • ScheduledTaskRegistrar.addFixedDelayTask(IntervalTask)
